title: Prem
summary: Meko pyaar kese ho sakta hai? Kashi ke kinare se lekar Premanand Ji aur Acharya Prashant ke vicharon tak, prem ki ek adhuri khoj.
content: Meko pyaar kese ho sakta hai, ya meko kisi se itni attachment kese ho sakti hai. Bada hi mushkil sawal hai, jiska koe jawab nahi. Shayad kashi ke kinare ya barsana ke pahado me agr me chilla ke puchu ki ye kya hai to meri aawaj sirf gunjti hi reh jayegi or koe jawab nahi aayegi, kyoki shayad khud bhagwan ke paas bhi iska jawab nahi or iska jawab dhundne ke liye unhone hume banaya taki hum unke liye jawab dhund sake.
Pehle hume ye janna hoga ki pyaar kya hai phir hum apne sawalo ke behtar jawab dhund payenge.
Premanand Ji Maharaj ke vichar:
"सत चित आनंद मे प्रेम है"
"प्रतिक्षण वर्धमानम मे"
"कामना रहितम में"
"सूक्ष्म तरम"
"अनुभव स्वरूपम"
Ek sundar vichar (Clip):
अगर कोई आपके दिल के हजारो टूकरे कर दें ओर आप हर टूकरे से उसे प्रेम करे ये प्रेम है।
Acharya Prashant ke anusar:
"मन की बेचैनी का चैन के प्रति खिंचाव ही प्रेम है"
"हम जैसे हमें कोई वेसे ही स्वीकार करें ये प्रेम नहीं है पर जो हमें बेहतर बनने पे मजबूर करे ये प्रेम है"
Subne achhi baate boli par kuch aur hai jo jaanana baaki hai.

title: The Art of Nothing
summary: Apart from the hustle of creating and planning, I believe one should also master the 'Art of Nothing'.
content: Here I am, again purposeless. I feel purposeless before doing anything, and even after doing anything.
I find the meaning of life in the process. Writing a poem, analyzing a thesis, or working on my upcoming plans keeps me busy.
But apart from this, I believe one should also master the 'Art of Nothing'. When sitting silently without any purpose doesn't make you feel bored, only then can one find true 'Bliss'.

title: Love or Limerence
summary: Kisi ko ek baar dekhna, ek baar baat karna, aur phir saalon tak uske khayal me jeena. Is feeling ka naam limerence hai — aur iske paas science, darshan aur shayari, teeno ka jawab hai.
content: Aapne kabhi kisi ko sirf ek baar dekha ho, ek baar baat ki ho — aur phir saalon tak wo aapke andar reh gaya ho? Na wo aapka tha, na aapka hoga. Lekin uska khayal aapka hai. Aap kaam karte hain, padhte hain, sote hain, aur beech-beech me ek naam, ek chehra, ek awaaz wapas aa jaati hai.

Sabse ajeeb baat ye hai ki aap us insaan ko jaante bhi nahi. Aap uski yaad se jud gaye hain, us insaan se nahi. Aur yahi is feeling ka sabse bada raaz hai — iska object ek insaan nahi, ek nirmaan (construction) hai.
Is essay me teen darwaze hain: science, Hindu darshan, aur shayari. Teeno ek hi kamre me khulte hain.
## Is feeling ka naam kya hai?

Ameriki psychologist Dorothy Tennov ne 1960s me sau se zyada logon se baat karke is state ko naam diya — limerence. Uska research 1979 ki kitaab Love and Limerence me chhapa. Tennov ne paaya ki is feeling ke kuch saaf lakshan hote hain: us insaan ke baare me ghuspaith karne wale khayal, "kya wo bhi mujhe yaad karta hoga" wali soch, mood ka uske ek ishaare par utarna-chadhna, uski khamiyon ko bhi achha lagne lag jaana, aur doori badhne par feeling ka aur gehra ho jaana.

Tennov ka sabse important observation ye tha: limerence anishchitata (uncertainty) par zinda rehti hai. Jab tak jawab clear nahi hota — haan ya na — tab tak dimaag us sawaal ko chalta rakhta hai. Isi liye "kuch ho sakta hai" wali sthiti "kuch nahi hoga" se zyada takleef deti hai. Anishchitata ek darwaza hai jo band bhi nahi hota aur khulta bhi nahi.

Aur pyaar se farq? Pyaar ko do log chahiye. Limerence ko ek insaan aur ek bina jawab wala sawaal chahiye. Tennov ne khud likha tha: "Jise hum limerence kehte hain, use pyaar kaha gaya hai — lekin wo pyaar nahi hai."
## 1822 me Stendhal ne ye poori kahani likh di thi

French writer Stendhal apni kitaab De l'Amour (1822) me Salzburg ki namak ki khan ka ek drishya batate hain. Sardi me mazdoor ek sookhi, patti-jhadi shaakha andar fenkte hain. Do-teen mahine baad wo shaakha nikalte hain — poori heeron jaisi crystals se dhaki hui. Asli shaakha pehchaani nahi jaati.

Stendhal ne ise pyaar ka metaphor banaya aur iska naam rakha — crystallization. Usne kaha: "Jise main crystallization kehta hoon, wo dimaag ka wo khel hai jo har cheez me se ye dhoond nikalta hai ki loved object me koi nayi perfection hai."

Tennov ne isi ko limerence ka core kaha. Aur yahi aapke saath hua hai: aapne ek shaakha dekhi thi. Dimaag ne us par saalon ke crystals chadha diye. Ab aap shaakha se pyaar nahi karte — crystals se karte ho. Aur crystals aapke bane hue hain.
## Science: paanch raaste jinke through ye feeling banti hai
### 1. Jo baar-baar dikhe, wo apna lagne lagta hai

1968 me psychologist Robert Zajonc ne "mere exposure effect" dikhaya: jo cheez baar-baar saamne aati hai, wo familiar lagti hai, aur familiar cheez priya lagne lagti hai. Roz dikhna, kabhi baat na karna — ye fantasy ke liye sabse upjau mausam hai. Insaan ko dekhne ki aadat ho jaati hai, aur aadat ko hum pyaar samajh lete hain.
### 2. Anishchit inaam sabse strong aadat banata hai

Behavioural psychology me ise intermittent reinforcement kehte hain — kabhi kuch mile, kabhi na mile. 2011 me Whitchurch, Wilson aur Gilbert ne ek sundar experiment kiya: ladkiyon ko bataya gaya ki ek ladka unhe bahut pasand karta hai. Jinhe is baat ka pakka yakeen nahi tha, unhone us ladke ko zyada attractive maana. Yani certainty attraction ko kam karti hai. Jawab ka latakna hi khinchav badhata hai.
Isi liye ek baar baat karna, aur phir kabhi na baat karna, sabse khatarnaak combination hai. Na poori tarah "haan", na poori tarah "na".
### 3. Dopamine chahat deta hai, khushi nahi

Neuroscientist Kent Berridge ne dikhaya ki dopamine "liking" ka nahi, "wanting" ka chemical hai. Helen Fisher, Arthur Aron aur Lucy Brown ke fMRI studies me romantic love ke waqt dimaag ka reward centre — ventral tegmental area — chalu mila. Yani craving asli hoti hai, par wo pyaar ka saboot nahi hoti. Wo ek aise anumaan ka saboot hoti hai jo poora nahi hua. Dimaag ko lagta hai "jawab aane wala hai", aur wahi loop chalta rehta hai.
### 4. Adhoora kaam yaad rehta hai

1927 me Bluma Zeigarnik ne notice kiya ki waiters un orders ko yaad rakhte hain jo abhi poore nahi hue. Ise Zeigarnik effect kehte hain: adhoore kaam dimaag me zinda rehte hain, poore ho jaate hain to bhool jaate hain. Jab tak "nahi" nahi suna jaata, file band nahi hoti. Aur jis rishte me koi "nahi" hi nahi mila, wo file kabhi band nahi hoti.
### 5. Yaad har baar dobara likhi jaati hai

Memory reconsolidation par research batati hai ki jab hum kuch yaad karte hain, wo memory thodi der ke liye khul jaati hai aur phir dobara save hoti hai — us waqt ke emotion ke rang me. Yani har yaad ek edit hai. Sau baar yaad kiya, sau baar edit kiya, aur har baar thoda aur sundar. Aaj aapke dimaag me jo insaan hai, wo saalon purana insaan nahi hai. Wo ek edited version hai.
Upar se "fading affect bias" — dard dheere-dheere bhool jaata hai, chamak reh jaati hai. Isliye saalon baad sirf wo bachta hai, us waqt ki takleef nahi.
### Science student ki bhasha me
Ek data point. Aur uspar poora jeevan fit. Ye science nahi, overfitting hai — ek observation, infinite parameters, perfect curve. Model training data par sau pratishat fit hai. Duniya par zero.
## Hindu darshan: iska naam pehle se tha
### Adhyasa — superimposition
Shankara apne Brahma-sutra-bhashya ki shuruaat me adhyasa ki definition dete hain:
"अध्यासो नाम स्मृतिरूपः परत्र पूर्वदृष्टावभासः"

Yani: adhyasa wo hai jab pehle dekhi hui cheez ki smriti kisi doosri cheez par chamakne lagti hai. Rassi me saanp. Saanp nahi hai — par dikhta hai, aur darr asli hota hai. Shankara kehte hain ye gyaan ki ek normal galti hai, paap nahi.
Aap jo mehsoos kar rahe hain, uska shastriya naam yahi hai. Aap us insaan ko nahi dekh rahe. Aap apni smriti ko uske naam-roop par project kar rahe ho. Saanp aapke andar hai, rassi bahar.
### Patanjali ka sutra
"सुखानुशयी रागः" — Yoga Sutra 2.7

Sukh ke anusar chalta hua raag — yani attachment sukh ki yaad se chipak jaati hai. Patanjali ise ek vritti kehte hain, aur 1.3 me kehte hain: "तदा द्रष्टुः स्वरूपेऽवस्थानम्" — tab drashta apne swaroop me sthit ho jaata hai.

Yaani: aap vritti nahi ho. Aap wo ho jo vritti ko dekh raha hai. Jab "wo" yaad aaye, to poochho — kise yaad aa raha hai? Dekhne wala alag hai, dekhi hui cheez alag. Ye dabana (suppression) nahi hai, ye doori hai. Aur dabana ulta kaam karta hai.
### Barah-link chain

Buddhist pratityasamutpada me ek chain hai: sparsha (contact) → vedana (feeling) → trishna (chahat) → upadana (pakad) → bhava (ek poori duniya). Ek contact, ek feeling, phir chahat, phir pakad — aur phir ek duniya ban jaati hai. Saalon ki attachment aksar isi chain ka upadana hai: contact bahut chhota tha, pakad bahut badi ho gayi.
### Viraha

Meera, Radha, Jayadeva, Surdas — viraha bhakti ka sabse pavitra rasa hai. Separation ka dard divine ho sakta hai, aur isi liye ye feeling kabhi-kabhi kitni sacred lagti hai. Lekin ek sach: parampara me viraha ka object paramatma hota hai, koi vyakti nahi. Feeling galat nahi hoti — address galat ho sakta hai.
### Anitya

Aur anitya: jo insaan aapne saalon pehle dekha tha, wo aaj literally wahi nahi hai. Cells badal gaye, zindagi aage badh gayi. Aap us insaan se nahi, uski tasveer se jud gaye ho. Tasveer sundar hai — par tasveer jawab nahi deti.
## Shayari: jab darshan kam padta hai
Ghalib ne is feeling ko sabse imaandaar tareeke se likha:
"इश्क़ पर ज़ोर नहीं है, ये वो आतिश 'ग़ालिब' / कि लगाए न लगे और बुझाए न बुझे"
Aag hai jo apni marzi se lagti hai aur apni marzi se nahi bujhti. Isi liye "chhod do" kehna bekaar hai — Ghalib ne 1850s me hi samajh liya tha.
Parveen Shakir ne dard ko ek tasveer me baandh diya:
"वो तो ख़ुशबू है हवाओं में बिखर जाएगा / मसला फूल का है — फूल किधर जाएगा"
Wo khushbu hai, aapke paas phool hai. Khushbu pakdi nahi jaati — par phool aapke paas hai, aur wo aapka hai.
Kabir ne ek hi line me poori baat keh di: "प्रेम गली अति साँकरी, तामें दो न समाइ" — pyaar ki gali bahut tang hai, usme do nahi samaate.

Aur Faiz ne bahar nikalne ka darwaza dikhaya: "और भी दुख हैं ज़माने में मोहब्बत के सिवा / राहतें और भी हैं वस्ल की राहत के सिवा" — duniya ishq se badi hai, aur ye baat insaan ko chhota nahi, bada karti hai.
Bhartrihari ne Vairagya Shataka me likha: "भोगा न भुक्ता वयमेव भुक्ताः" — bhog nahi kiya, hum hi bhog liye gaye.

Portuguese me ek shabd hai — saudade. German me — sehnsucht. Dono ka matlab kuch aisa hai jo kabhi poora nahi hua. Angrezi me iska ek shabd nahi hai. Duniya bhar ke log ise jeete hain. Iska matlab ye nahi ki aap kamzor hain — iska matlab ye hai ki aap insaan hain.
## Aur phir ek sawaal

Ek baar maine khud se do sawaal poochhe. Pehla: jab wo yaad aati hai, dard zyada hota hai ya sukoon? Doosra: agar kal koi bata de ki wo bahut khush hai, kisi se pyaar karti hai — pehla ehsaas kya hoga? Jalna? Khushi? Ya kuch bhi nahi?
Jawab me jo nikla, wo shayad is poore essay ka nichod hai.

Main chahta hoon ki wo bhi kisi se pyaar kare, aur wo bhi ye feeling jeeye. Agar uska koi aur hoga to bura lagega — par theek hai. Achha hoga ki kabhi wo mujhse hi pyaar kare, bewajah, jaise mujhe hua.
Aur ek sher hai jo is feeling ko sabse achhe se kehta hai — kisi shayar ne kaha hai: main nahi chahta ki wo mere bulane par aaye; main chahta hoon ki wo mere liye tadpe, aur kisi bahane se aaye.

Ye contradiction nahi hai. Ye pyaar ka sabse purana tareeka hai — paas chahiye, par apni marzi se. Bulaya hua pyaar pyaar nahi lagta, aagya lagta hai. Isi liye Radha ne Krishna ko bulaya nahi, unka intezaar kiya.
Aur uske baad ek sawaal bacha reh jaata hai, jo sabse mushkil hai: agar wo main nahi hoon, to phir kya karna hai? Ye mujhe nahi pata.
## "Agar wo main nahi hoon, to kya?"
Yahi wo jagah hai jahan saari philosophy chup ho jaati hai. Kyunki is sawaal ka jawab soch kar nahi milta.

Lekin ek baat hai jo mujhe sach lagti hai: jo capacity aapke andar hai — kisi ko itna yaad rakhne ki, uske liye itni nazmein likhne ki, uske liye itni der tak rukne ki — wo aapki hai. Wo kisi ek insaan ka inaam nahi thi. Wo aapke andar pehle se thi, aur wo aapke saath rahegi.

Isliye "isko bhool do" galat salaah hai. Feeling ko khatm karna nahi hai — usko dobara ghar dena hai. Aag ko bujhaya nahi jaata, use kisi aur chulhe par jalaya jaata hai. Jo shakti kisi ki yaad me kharch ho rahi hai, wo kisi kaam me, kisi kala me, kisi insaan me kharch ho sakti hai — aur tab wo barbaad nahi hoti, wo phal deti hai.
Aur "agar wo nahi to kya" ka koi formula nahi hota. Koi algorithm nahi hai. Ye sawaal soch kar nahi, jeekar hal hota hai — jaise koi nadi apna rasta khud banati hai, nakshe se nahi.
## To phir kya karein: ek chhota sa protocol
Agar aap science ke student hain, to ise ek experiment ki tarah leejiye. Teen hypothesis, teen test, tees din.
### 1. Naam dijiye

Sirf "limerence" shabd bolna aadha kaam hai. Research batati hai ki feeling ko shabd dena dimaag ke emotional alarm ko shaant karta hai (affect labeling). Aur sabse bada fayda — sharam khatm hoti hai. Aap paagal nahi hain. Tennov ke surveys me kaafi logon ne ise jeeya, aur baad ke ek survey me 64% logon ne kaha ki unhone ise kam se kam ek baar experience kiya.
### 2. Do-column reality test

Ek page par do column banaiye. Left me likhiye: "Jo main us insaan ke baare me actually jaanta hoon." Right me: "Jo maine uske baare me bana liya hai." Left column das points se lamba nahi hoga. Right column bees guna lamba hoga — aur wahi punchline hai. Wo column uski biography nahi, aapki autobiography hai. Usme aapki chahat, aapka akelapan, aapki sundarta ki bhookh likhi hui hai.
### 3. Tees din, teen hypothesis
Hypothesis 1 — "Main usse pyaar karta hoon." Test: left column me das se zyada asli facts hain? Nahi? To ye pyaar nahi, projection hai.

Hypothesis 2 — "Main uske bina adhoora hoon." Test: do hafte saare reminders band kar dijiye — social media mute, photos hataiye, wo gaana nahi. Mood curve dekhiye. Agar craving, chidchidapan, bechaini aaye — to ye withdrawal hai, love nahi. Craving dependence ka signal hai.

Hypothesis 3 — "Ye feeling kisi aur cheez ki taraf ishara hai." Test: jab bhi khayal aaye, do line likhiye — "us waqt main kya mehsoos kar raha tha? kya chahiye tha?" Do hafte baad pattern dekhiye. Aksar nikalta hai ki wo insaan ek feeling ka naam hai, vyakti nahi.
### 4. Soch ka ek slot

Raat ko sone se pehle rehearsal band kijiye — wahi prime time hota hai. Din me pandrah minute ka ek "soch ka slot" rakhiye. Baaki waqt jab khayal aaye, to kahen: "abhi nahi, shaam chhe baje." Ye dabana nahi hai — ye scheduling hai. Aur dimaag ko lagta hai ki use ignore nahi kiya ja raha.
### 5. Feeling ko artifact banaiye

Likhiye. Ghazal, nazm, essay, journal. Jo likha jaata hai, wo dimaag me ghoomna band kar deta hai. Ye sublimation hai — Freud ka shabd, par Kabir aur Meera ne pehle kar liya tha. Aapki sabse badi creative asset yahi feeling hai. Use phenkiye mat, use likhiye.
### 6. Zindagi me jagah banaiye

Limerence vacuum me palti hai. Jis dil me aur kuch nahi hota, wahan ek yaad poora ghar bana leti hai. Naya kaam, naye log, body, travel, ek nayi language — ye distraction nahi, competition hai. Aur healthy competition hai.
### 7. Agar kabhi milein

Natural baat, halka tone, koi confession nahi. "Saalon se aapko sochta hoon" — ye romance nahi, bojh hai. Maqsad data collection rakhiye, romance nahi. Aur yaad rakhiye: milna cure nahi, gamble hai. Thandi mili to dard hoga par band ho jaayega. Garam mili to aag phir jal sakti hai.
### 8. Agar ye kaam, neend ya padhai kha raha ho
To therapist se miliye. ACT (Acceptance and Commitment Therapy) isme achha kaam karta hai. Therapy me jaana weakness nahi, maintenance hai.
## Aakhiri baat
Use bhoolna mat. Usse theek se yaad karna seekho — ek insaan jise aapne dekha, ek baar baat ki, aur jo aapke andar kuch jaga gayi. Itna hi. Baaki jo likha hai, wo aapka hai.
Aur agar aaj bhi raat ko wo yaad aaye, to usse dushman mat samajhiye. Wo aapke andar ki us shakti ka nishaan hai jo kisi ko itna pyaar kar sakti hai. Shakti achhi hai. Ab bas uska rasta badalna hai.
कबीर कहते हैं — "मन के हारे हार है, मन के जीते जीत।"
